name: SelectPanel
description: `SelectPanel` is a data-driven, filterable picker built with Base UI Combobox and Primer's Popover and Dialog primitives.

props.name: actionListProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the underlying list.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the panel along the anchor's edge.

props.name: anchorId
props.description: Id of the element the panel is anchored to.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description:
Ref to your own anchor element, when you render the anchor yourself.
Ref to the anchor element the panel renders.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the panel.

props.name: cssAnchorPositioningSettings
props.description: How the panel falls back when CSS anchor positioning cannot place it.

props.name: defaultFilterValue
props.description: Initial filter query when the panel owns its own state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the panel starts open when it owns its own state.

props.name: disableFullscreenOnNarrow
props.description: Keeps the panel anchored on narrow viewports instead of filling the screen.

props.name: disableSelectOnHover
props.description: Stops hovering an option from making it the active descendant.

props.name: displayInViewport
props.description: Keeps the panel within the viewport rather than its nearest scrolling ancestor.

props.name: filterValue
props.description: Controls the filter query. Supply it with `onFilterChange` to own the state.

props.name: focusOutBehavior
props.description: Whether keyboard navigation stops or wraps at the first and last option.

props.name: focusPrependedElements
props.description: Includes elements rendered before the list in the keyboard focus order.

props.name: groupMetadata
props.description: Group headers, matched to options by their group id.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the panel.

props.name: id
props.description: Identifier for the panel, used to associate it with its anchor.

props.name: initialLoadingType
props.description: Which affordance the first load shows.

props.name: inputLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the filter input.

props.name: items
props.description: Options to choose from.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading affordance in place of the options.

props.name: message
props.description: Content shown in place of the options, for an error or other terminal state.

props.name: notice
props.description: Banner shown above the options, for a warning that does not replace them.

props.name: onActiveDescendantChanged
props.type: ((current: HTMLElement | undefined, previous: HTMLElement | undefined, directlyActivated: boolean) => void)
props.description: Called when keyboard focus moves to a different option.

props.name: onCancel
props.description:
Called when the panel is dismissed without a selection.
Called when the panel is dismissed without a selection. Required for a modal panel.

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called with the new query whenever the filter input changes.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes, with the gesture that caused it.

props.name: onScrollEnd
props.description: Called when the options are scrolled to the end, for loading another page.

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.type: (selected: SelectPanelItem[] | SelectPanelItem | undefined, details?: ChangeEventDetails | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the new selection whenever it changes.

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the panel is open. Supply it with `onOpenChange` to own the state.

props.name: overlayProps
props.description: Size and positioning of the panel overlay.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown on the anchor when nothing is selected.

props.name: placeholderText
props.description: Placeholder shown in the filter input.

props.name: renderAnchor
props.description:
Set to null when the anchor is rendered outside the panel and referenced by `anchorRef`.
Renders the anchor yourself, receiving the props that make it control the panel.

props.name: renderGroup
props.description: Renders each group yourself.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renders each option yourself.

props.name: scrollContainerRef
props.description: Ref to the scrolling options container.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Extra control shown in the panel's footer.

props.name: selected
props.description: Currently selected option or options.

props.name: selectionVariant
props.description: Whether one option or several may be selected.

props.name: setInitialFocus
props.description: Moves focus to the filter input when the panel opens.

props.name: showItemDividers
props.description: Draws a divider between options.

props.name: showSelectAll
props.description: Shows a control that selects or clears every option at once.

props.name: showSelectedOptionsFirst
props.description: Moves selected options to the top of the list.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Supporting text shown below the title.

props.name: textInputProps
props.description: Extra props forwarded to the filter input.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown at the top of the panel.

props.name: variant
props.description:
How the panel presents itself. `anchored` attaches it to its anchor.
How the panel presents itself. `modal` presents it over the page and requires `onCancel`.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Renders only the visible options, for a long uniform list.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the panel.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the button to fill the width of its container.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter, for a button that acts on a known quantity.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents activation and removes the button from the keyboard order.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the button temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable, so its reason can be announced.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses activation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the button is loading.

props.name: notificationIndicator
props.description:
Shows a dot for new activity on the button boundary or on the leading visual. `leadingVisual` requires a
`leadingVisual`. The dot is not announced, so describe the activity in the accessible name or description.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the button.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron for a button that opens something.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Icon shown after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight of the button. Use `primary` for the main action and `danger` for a destructive one.

props.name: alignContent
props.description: Whether the label sits centred or hugs the start edge when visuals are present.

props.name: count
props.description: Number shown in a trailing counter.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents navigation and removes the link from the keyboard order.

props.name: href
props.description: URL the secondary action navigates to.

props.name: inactive
props.description: Marks the link temporarily unavailable while keeping it focusable.

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: Lets a long label wrap onto more than one line instead of being clipped.

props.name: leadingVisual
props.description: Icon shown before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces the leading visual with a spinner and suppresses navigation.

props.name: loadingAnnouncement
props.description: Text announced to assistive technology while the link is loading.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Called when the link is activated.

props.name: render
props.description: Renders the link as your own element, for a router link that still needs button styling.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size of the link.

props.name: trailingAction
props.description: Icon shown at the far end, conventionally a chevron.

props.name: trailingVisual
props.description: Icon shown after the label.
